evidence_basis: Static source inspection and precise execution interleavings; no native runtime proof observed by this reviewer.

findings.title: Case version advancement invalidates C17 evidence retained by the accepted ledger
preconditions: A valid record-only calculation R is persisted and issued at case version v.
An authorized ready contribution cites R in output.evidenceRefs.
Source records, authorization and case incarnation remain unchanged.
execution_trace: Analysis acceptance retains output.evidenceRefs in the ledger and increments the case to v+1; AlternativeDraft promotion has equivalent preservation and version advancement.
Subsequent cases.read includes ledger evidence and requires fresh or historical evidence.
Real C17 resolver invokes requests.read and results.readForCalculation.
Both stores require current case.version to equal stored caseRef.version v; current version is v+1.
Resolver returns unavailable and cases.read returns case-evidence-unavailable.
findings.impact: The successful acceptance can make the same case and its ledger evidence unavailable on reload. This is an availability/continuity failure, not an access escalation.
limitations: A native producer emitting and accepting this contribution was not observed; the precondition and failure were inspected statically.
Nested C17 replay is not required: R may be record-only.
Synthetic fixtures keeping all case versions equal do not establish native continuity.
bounded_fix: Keep ordinary public calculation reads current-only.
Introduce an explicit authorized historical ledger-consumer path without rewriting original caseRef.
Require current authorization, canonical origin/request/result, same case and incarnation, an allowed historical horizon, and exact reference membership in the persisted authorized ledger.
Derive ledger membership from persisted snapshots, not caller assertions.
Revalidate source continuity; deny revoked, cross-case, different-incarnation, future-horizon and nonmember evidence.
Coordinate the external withCalculationCase seam; preserve the evidence contract and avoid blanket equality-to-greater-than substitutions.
recommended_actions_checks: Real C08 stores plus actual C17 composition: issue R, accept authorized contribution citing R, reload case at v+1, resolve ledger evidence.
Negatives: changed source, revoked access, different incarnation, different case, reference not in persisted ledger, future horizon.
Ordinary public C17 read still refuses historical R.
Synthetic callback and native proof receipts reported separately.

findings.title: Binding-global replay guard mistakes concurrent independent work for ancestry
execution_trace: active/checking are maps keyed by digest of the binding, shared across independent calls.
While issue(R, context) awaits a loader, a second independent issue(R, context) sees R active and returns calculation-replay-cycle.
With 16 independent shallow calculations active, a 17th in the same binding fails the shared size limit even though every ancestry depth is one.

The current BCS performs ordered internal traversal, but scenario-port checkEvidence still resolves distinct top-level refs with Promise.all, making an independent 17-calculation batch a reachable caller pattern.
findings.impact: Valid calculations are rejected depending on interleaving. No unauthorized success, ACL bypass or deadlock is established.
limitations: Current external BCS uses explicit ancestors and mapSfEvidenceInOrder; this finding does not blame its superseded Promise.all traversal.
Nested host opt-in remains absent in the inspected composition; independent record-only calculations still exercise the shared guard.
No product execution or local race reproduction was performed.
bounded_fix: Track ancestry privately per replay chain with the depth bound applied per path.
Separate active-work coalescing/serialization from cycle detection.
If coalescing identical work, retain the same authorization pass and never cache authority across calls.
Serializing scenario-port evidence batches is a possible local mitigation but does not alone repair concurrent issue callers.
Keep actual self-cycle, A-to-B-to-A and excessive-depth rejection.
recommended_actions_checks: Explicit promise barriers: two independent calls for the same R both succeed.
Seventeen distinct record-only calculations of depth one succeed.
Self-cycle, A-to-B-to-A and path depth above limit fail closed.
Actual Planner checkEvidence consumer exercises the batch.

Planner persistence replays before and after persistence and checks selected case and canonical results.
BI snapshot/destination checks retain projection and authority fences; no access widening established.
ChoiceRecord historical identity does not authorize apply; UI human intent, review digest, current authority and domain receipt remain required.
Financial source coverage complete is not Choice, preparation, approval or application proof.

No additional concrete nested-domain transaction deadlock established.
